output_essentials: --available-tools disables all other tools; --excluded-tools disables only specified tools
Denial rules always take precedence over allow rules, even --allow-all-tools
Tool visibility and approval are separate
shell(command:*?) matches a command; omitted argument allows all shell commands; :* allows a stem prefix
write(path?) matches file-writing tools, except shell invocations; absolute paths scope rules to one location
url(domain-or-url?) governs shell and web-fetch URL access
Default path access includes cwd/subdirectories and system temporary directory; --disallow-temp-dir removes automatic temporary-directory access
--allow-all and --yolo equal --allow-all-tools --allow-all-paths --allow-all-urls
